tool_args.rationale: The supplied mechanism guidance identifies co-activation of the sink-coupled base and dual-horizon adaptation. The initial rows are short-horizon only; the slow-horizon discriminating probe is needed to calibrate behavior near the forecast horizon before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilots only cover H≤0.48, so the long-horizon adaptation/reversal remains unidentified for the target H=20.3.
More short-horizon trajectory samples would not resolve the long-horizon behavior as directly.
It is not relevant to the identified temporal ambiguity.
